clips.title: The story
paras: In Southshore, Magistrate Henry Maleb keeps order in the Alliance's chief coastal stronghold in Hillsbrad Foothills. The port town faces threats from the Forsaken and the Syndicate.

Magistrate Henry Maleb governs from Southshore's town hall, one of the last true Alliance settlements in Lordaeron. Forsaken forces threaten the town from the north and west, while highwaymen prowl the foothills. Maleb took office after the previous magistrate was mysteriously assassinated, an act he blames on the Syndicate. He means to avoid the same fate. His investigations seek hidden assassins, Syndicate supply networks, and the nobles directing them from the ruins of Alterac.
